why: The issue's 'never accept Start with an inert required slot'. The reasons would still render on the offending card, so the pane would still LOOK like it was refusing -- while Start stayed clickable and launched a match with an unassigned or driverless tank. Computing a refusal and not enforcing it is the failure this pins. Two roving-tabindex cases it named until issue #1093 are not killers: in the 150-test `hud.navigation.test.ts` they failed only because "works with no store at all" fails under this mutation before its own `dispose`, and the HUD it leaves listening on `window` took later key presses in that file (measured the same with the display cache and without). Split into `hud.roving.test.ts`, they pass.
